mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fcc_extension WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND extension=#{extension} AND status='ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fcc_phone_binding_challenge(tenant_id,owner_work_no,extension,code_hash,status,expires_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{owner},#{extension},#{hash},'PENDING',DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 2 MINUTE)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE extension=#{extension},code_hash=#{hash},status='PENDING',channel_uuid=NULL,expires_at=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 2 MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId,owner_work_no AS owner FROM fcc_phone_binding_challenge WHERE code_hash=#{hash} AND extension=#{extension} AND status='PENDING' AND expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FOR UPDATE
SELECT tenant_id FROM fcc_phone_binding_lock WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fcc_agent a JOIN fcc_agent_presence p ON p.agent_id=a.id AND p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (a.work_no=#{owner} OR a.current_extension=#{extension}) AND p.active_call_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_agent_endpoint_binding b JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id=b.agent_id AND a.tenant_id=b.tenant_id SET b.status='DISABLED',b.valid_to=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND b.endpoint_type='SIP' AND b.status='ENABLED' AND (a.work_no=#{owner} OR b.endpoint_value=#{extension})
UPDATE fcc_extension SET agent_work_no=NULL,agent_name=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (agent_work_no=#{owner} OR extension=#{extension})
UPDATE fcc_agent SET current_extension=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (work_no=#{owner} OR current_extension=#{extension})

UPDATE fcc_extension e JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND a.work_no=#{owner} AND a.status='ENABLED' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL SET e.agent_work_no=a.work_no,e.agent_name=a.agent_name WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND e.extension=#{extension} AND e.status='ENABLED' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE fcc_agent SET current_extension=#{extension} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND work_no=#{owner} AND status='ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fcc_agent_endpoint_binding(id,tenant_id,agent_id,endpoint_type,extension_id,endpoint_value,priority,status) SELECT #{id},#{tenant},a.id,'SIP',e.id,e.extension,1,'ENABLED' FROM fcc_agent a JOIN fcc_extension e ON e.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.work_no=#{owner} AND e.extension=#{extension} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_phone_binding_challenge SET status='CONSUMED',channel_uuid=#{channel} WHERE code_hash=#{hash} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT extension,CASE WHEN status='PENDING' AND expires_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE status END AS status FROM fcc_phone_binding_challenge WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND owner_work_no=#{owner}
